open_questions: When was chest discomfort first recorded, and what was its character, duration and associated features?
Which medications were started, stopped, held or changed?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?
What medications were prescribed for chest discomfort or cardiovascular risk, and when were they started?
Was any cardiac investigation (e.g., ECG, troponin, stress test) ordered or performed, and when?
Has the patient been referred to cardiology or another specialist for this symptom?
What cardiovascular risk factors (e.g., hypertension, diabetes, smoking) are documented, and when were they first noted?
Was a formal diagnosis (e.g., angina, CAD, GERD) assigned, and when was it first recorded?
